verdict.rationale: FireHydrant offers AI-generated incident summaries created as soon as an incident is declared (docs-11, docs-52), AI-drafted retrospectives that produce structured timelines and lessons learned (docs-13, docs-35, docs-45), and an AI Scribe that joins meetings/Zoom to capture call notes and chat insights (docs-29, docs-64). This directly matches the story's live summaries, drafted updates, and scribed call notes. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of these AI features' accuracy in production incidents, and clearer evidence of real-time 'live' updating (vs. point-in-time generation) during an active incident.
